primitives.name: Defensive Pressure Conversion Rate
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## Cross-team flags for Sunday Week 8 board **Pressure conversion (def_sack_rate_pct high = QB under duress):** - Scan `def_sack_rate_pct` across all 32 teams — teams with high sack rates + low `sack_rate_allowed_pct` on offense are the best 0.25-sack prop candidates (tandem gate: rusher pressure × opponent sack-allowed).
primitives.assumptions: Linear correlation between defensive pressure and QB instability; binary outcome for prop validity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High R_sack and low R_allow define optimal prop regime.

layer2.mapping: GSI Bayesian model for prop likelihood; GSE state transition for pressure-induced tempo shift.
layer2.telemetry: Observed sack rate vs. expected sack rate deviation.

primitives.name: Red-Zone Scoring Probability
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Red-zone TD rate (redzone_td_pct low = FG stall candidate):** - Teams with low redzone_td_pct → kicking "OVER 1.5 FGs" leans.
primitives.assumptions: Low P_rz correlates with increased field goal attempts and lower scoring variance.

layer2.mapping: GSI Poisson process for FG frequency; GSE temporal decay model for scoring efficiency.
layer2.telemetry: Observed red-zone TD rate vs. historical average.

primitives.name: Target Concentration Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Target concentration (hhi_target_concentration high = WR1 dependent):** - High HHI + high wr1_target_share → WR1 props more stable; WR2/WR3 props more volatile.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H_{targ}': 'Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of target distribution (dimensionless)', 'T_{wr1}': 'WR1 target share (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: HHI > 0.5 and T_wr1 > 0.3 indicate high dependency on primary receiver.
primitives.breakdown_regime: HHI > 0.5 and T_wr1 > 0.3 define stable WR1 regime.

layer2.mapping: GSI entropy-based volatility measure; GSE receiver role stability model.
layer2.telemetry: Observed HHI and WR1 share against baseline distributions.
